Self.Wiki: This map object represents a character that is not placed in normal play, used as a stand-in or for cutscenes. It has the same fields as an enemy.

NpcThinkParamId.Wiki: The AI parameters this character should use.

NpcParamId.Wiki: The property parameters this character should use.

TalkID.Wiki: The ID of a talk ESD used by the character.

Unk15.Wiki: Read by the game when the character is set up, together with the Idle Animation ID. ON for about 230 enemies.

CharaInitParamId.Wiki: The ID in CharaInitParam determining equipment and stats for humans.

HitPartName.Wiki: The collision that controls loading of the enemy.

PatrolRouteName.Wiki: The walk route this enemy follows.

ScenarioPlacementParamID.Wiki: A ScenarioPlacementParam row (101 to 309 in the game files). The row that actually changes the character is chosen by the Scenario Placement keys.

CondemnedSpEffectSetParamIds.Wiki: A second group of SpEffect sets, applied in addition to SpEffect Set ID only when the character is created with a special flag (not yet identified).

BackupEventAnimID.Wiki: The animation ID for this enemy to idle with.

Unk3C.Wiki: Read by the loading screen. -1 on most enemies, 1 or 2 on about 300.

Unk3E.Wiki: Read by the game when the character is created. -1, or 0 to 575 (often multiples of 10).

SpEffectSetParamIds.Wiki: A set of SpEffects that are applied to this enemy.

OverrideItemLotEventFlagID0.Wiki: If this event flag is on, Override Item Lot 1 is given instead of the enemy's normal item lot. Checked before the second pair. 0 for none. Used by the bosses of m47 to m49, as in Team Fight events.

OverrideItemLotParamID0.Wiki: The item lot given while Override Item Lot Event Flag 1 is on. -1 or 0 for none.

OverrideItemLotEventFlagID1.Wiki: If this event flag is on (and the first is off), Override Item Lot 2 is given instead of the enemy's normal item lot. 0 for none.

OverrideItemLotParamID1.Wiki: The item lot given while Override Item Lot Event Flag 2 is on. -1 or 0 for none.

AltNpcParamId.Wiki: An NpcParam row used instead of NPC Param ID when the character is created under a special condition (not yet identified). 0 keeps NPC Param ID. Only the bosses of m47 to m49 set it: the same row, or a variant of it.
